author: John Hammond
description:
The pace of internet-wide exploitation is changing. New vulnerabilities and proof-of-concept exploits can make their way into botnet activity much faster than they used to, sometimes within the same day.

Andrew Morris of GreyNoise joins me to discuss what this means for defenders and how Project Swarm can help provide visibility into activity happening across the internet.

Full video: https://youtu.be/NQJco54_Zq4?si=O_2Ay4jwp3uZA-MI
title: Attacks Are Accelerating
